svg.aria-label: Constructed standards and population: the number distribution of log₁₀ M has mean 4.2 and SD 0.35; mass weighting changes its center. Extra chromatographic broadening is σV=0.25 mL and area is normalized to one. D accumulates in elution order, from large to small.
